name: photo-generator
description: Style-locked images from a project's committed design direction (procedural, model-free; a model-backed generator plugs in at Phase 13). photo_verify re-checks every image against the direction's palette.

tools.name: photo_generate
tools.description: Render a PNG locked to a design direction's palette and record it

tools.name: photo_verify
tools.description: Re-read a stored image and check it matches its direction's palette
